name: Duolingo
hiring_system: greenhouse (custom React front); 3 freelance/contract roles separately on Breezy (duolingo.breezy.hr)
page_total_how: Playwright render of https://careers.duolingo.com/ (web fonts must load or the app renders nothing) + click 'View all jobs': 63 job links careers.duolingo.com/jobs/<gh id> = the feed's 63 ids. The page builds its list from boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/duolingo/departments (63 jobs).
notes: The bookmarks' type=Intern / type=Thrive Program are derived from the Greenhouse custom field 'Req Type': 'University - Graduating Intern' -> Intern, 'University - Thrive Intern' -> Thrive Program, 'University - New Grad' -> New Grad (0 Thrive postings today), so Greenhouse covers both. Breezy (https://duolingo.breezy.hr/json) holds only freelance contract roles; the page's freelance loader is stubbed to [] and it only links out ('View freelance jobs'). Breezy is optional (custom:breezy, extra_sources below). See notes/duolingo.md.

extra_sources.page_total_how: Playwright render of https://duolingo.breezy.hr/: 3 /p/<friendly_id> links = the 3 JSON ids
extra_sources.why: freelance/contract roles only (type 'Contract'); never student roles
